newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity fund flows down in 2-day period-survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity fund flows down in 2-day period-survey.

text.p: U.S. equity funds took in an estimated $437 million for the two days ended August 4, for a month pace of $4.8 billion, Mutual Fund Trim Tabs reported on Wednesday.
In the previous three-day period ending July 31, U.S. equity funds took in an estimated $2.5 billion, it said.
Outflows from international equity funds were unusually high at $1.8 billion, the tracking agency said. In the prior period, an estimated $1.4 billion went into international equity funds, it said.
Total equity funds registered outflows of $1.4 billion compared to inflows of $3.9 billion in the previous three-day period, the firm said.
Aggressive growth funds saw outflows $349 million versus inflows of $278 million, while growth funds took in $324 million compared to $870 million, it said.
Funds into growth and income funds also dropped to $466 million from $1.4 billion, the tracking firm said.
Total flows into bond funds rose to $504 million from $159 milion, with $158 million going into high-yield bond funds.
